summary_1line: Rama and Lakshmana meet the vulture Jatayu, who explains his divine lineage and pledges to guard Sita while they dwell at Panchavati.

image_candidates.scene_text: The great vulture Jatayu stands in the forest before Rama and Lakshmana, speaking gently while the princes regard him with cautious respect.
Rama embraces the aged vulture Jatayu in the forest after learning he was a friend of King Dasaratha.
